correctness.rationale: For all L>=0 uniform n in [0,2^L), Kummer gives X=v2(binomial(2n,n))=s2(n), Y=v2(binomial(3n,n)) equal to binary carries when adding n and 2n. State (previous bit b_{j-1},incoming carry c_j), initialize (0,0), read L bits with weight u^{b_j}v^{c_{j+1}}, include one terminal zero-padded carry via f=(1,1,1,v). Thus P_L=e M^L f and sum z^L P_L=e(I−zM)^−1 f. Independently built symbolic 4x4 matrix, recomputed exact N and D via determinant/Cramer; both equal pinned polynomials. Differentiating formally at u=v=1 and partial-fraction coefficient extraction yields means E X=L/2, E Y=L/2−2/3+(3+(−1)^L)/(6*2^L) and mixed covariance 5L/12−4/9+(9+7(−1)^L)/(36*2^L). Independent direct integer valuations for all n<2^L, L=0..9, agree. The matrix proof, not bounded brute force, handles all L.
residual_risks: Terminal zero-padding carry is necessary and explicitly included; omission would produce wrong Y at some n.
The result is for complete dyadic intervals and only 2-adic valuations, not arbitrary intervals or prime p.
